task: Bind required exact-head evidence from existing parallel workflows into the canonical Resumable Verification and Completion Truth authority without creating another gate.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The current Completion Truth authority can consume evidence produced inside normal CI, but a mandatory proof produced by a separate exact-head workflow can be either permanently MISSING or silently moved outside the machine-readable Completion Contract. The Brabus revalidation exposed both failure modes: including GUARD-TEMPLATE-FACTORY deadlocked Truth because CI could not see the sibling workflow artifact; removing it let Completion Truth become VERIFIED_DONE before Template Factory completed. The fix must transport external exact-head evidence into the existing Resumable Verification manifest while preserving one Completion Truth authority.
observableOutcomes: Completion Contract references to supported external guards are detected from structured evidence references rather than hard-coded per-task prose.
Normal CI waits only for an external guard that the active Completion Contract actually requires.
A successful external workflow is insufficient by itself: exact head, branch, state version, producer run and machine-readable artifact truth must all agree.
Validated external proof is normalized into the existing Resumable Verification final evidence manifest and consumed by the existing Completion Truth Gate.
Missing, failed, stale, wrong-head, wrong-branch, malformed, incomplete or ambiguous external evidence fails closed.
Development transactions that do not require an external guard do not wait for Template Factory and preserve current CI behavior.
No second quality gate, Completion Truth authority, Template Factory authority or release authority is created.
unresolvedRisks: Cross-workflow waiting increases CI wall time only for transactions whose Completion Contract explicitly requires the external proof.
The first supported producer is GUARD-TEMPLATE-FACTORY; future external guards require an explicit adapter/validator instead of generic trust in arbitrary workflow artifacts.
GitHub Actions artifact/API availability is an external transport dependency; unavailable evidence remains BLOCK rather than guessed PASS.

in: Existing Completion Contract evidence references and Guard Registry identities.
Existing Resumable Verification final evidence manifest and Completion Truth Gate.
Generic external-proof requirement detection for guards absent from the local verification plan.
Exact-head Template Factory workflow/artifact transport as the first supported external producer.
CI orchestration needed to wait boundedly, download, validate and hand off required external proof.
Adversarial regression coverage for stale/mismatched/failed/malformed/incomplete external proof.
out: Any Builder, Template Factory maturity model, storefront runtime or template implementation.
Any second blocking gate, Completion Truth authority, release authority or Template Factory authority.
Weakening Release Risk, Sentinel, Proof Semantics, Plan Before Code or existing exact-head provenance rules.
Treating workflow success without machine-readable artifact proof as completion evidence.
General trust of arbitrary external workflow artifacts without an explicit validator.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This change modifies the evidence path used by the authority that decides whether a Development Transaction is actually complete. The highest practical assurance level is exact-head fail-closed provenance, artifact/workflow decision reconciliation, bounded transport, explicit supported-producer validation and adversarial proof against evidence laundering, without adding a parallel completion system.

acceptanceCriteria: A Completion Contract requiring GUARD-TEMPLATE-FACTORY cannot reach VERIFIED_DONE until an exact-head successful Template Factory artifact is validated and present in the canonical final evidence set.
A Completion Contract that does not require GUARD-TEMPLATE-FACTORY does not wait for or synthesize Template Factory evidence.
Wrong-head, wrong-branch, failed workflow, missing run identity, invalid contract, invalid checksum, incomplete browser matrix or artifact errors all fail closed.
An older successful artifact from the same branch cannot satisfy a newer exact-head requirement.
Workflow success plus artifact BLOCK/incomplete state cannot be laundered into PASS.
External evidence is merged into the existing Resumable Verification final-evidence-manifest and the existing Completion Truth Gate remains the only completion decision authority.
The handoff helper is part of verification-engine identity so later semantic changes invalidate stale resumable-promotion proof.
Quality tests, TypeScript and production build remain green on the exact foundation head.
Release Risk stays inside budget for this isolated quality/release foundation transaction.
invariants: External proof transport never decides completion; it only normalizes validated evidence.
Exact head, branch, state version, producer workflow/run and artifact truth are part of evidence identity.
UNKNOWN or unavailable external proof is BLOCK, never probable PASS.
Existing producer authority remains authoritative for its own result; the handoff cannot rewrite or upgrade it.
Verification-engine semantics include the handoff implementation and CI wiring.

failureModes: Normal CI verifies local evidence and closes while mandatory sibling workflow proof is still running.
A required external guard remains permanently MISSING because its artifact is never normalized into the local manifest.
Branch-only lookup selects an older successful workflow artifact for a newer head.
Workflow status is success while its machine-readable artifact is incomplete or contains errors.
Malformed or absent external artifact is silently ignored.
An unrelated development transaction waits for Template Factory even though its Completion Contract never references it.
The handoff semantics change without invalidating resumable verification promotion identity.
edgeCases: Completion Contract is closed and must not create a fresh external wait.
Multiple local evidence references plus one external evidence reference exist in the same requirement.
A producer run is queued/in-progress while an older exact-branch success exists.
A producer run is terminal failure with a leftover artifact.
Duplicate external evidence records target the same guard.
Unsupported external guard is referenced and must fail visible rather than guessed.

alternatives.summary: Transport validated sibling-workflow proof into the existing Resumable Verification evidence manifest and let the existing Completion Truth decide closure.
alternatives.reason: Preserves one completion authority, avoids proof duplication and closes both the permanent-MISSING and false-closure failure modes.

alternatives.summary: Remove external proof from Completion Contract and rely on a manual pre-merge check.
alternatives.reason: The Brabus run already proved Completion Truth can become VERIFIED_DONE before the sibling proof finishes; manual policy is not machine-enforced completion truth.

alternatives.summary: Create a dedicated cross-workflow completion gate beside Completion Truth.
alternatives.reason: Would duplicate blocking responsibility and recreate the rule/gate ping-pong architecture the Control Plane is intended to eliminate.

challenge.scenario: The sibling Template Factory workflow is still running while normal CI reaches its Completion Truth step.
challenge.finding: Immediate Truth evaluation sees required evidence as missing and either deadlocks or tempts developers to remove the requirement.
challenge.resolution: CI detects the required external guard from the Completion Contract and waits boundedly for the exact-head producer run before Resumable Verification finalization.

challenge.scenario: An older successful Template Factory run exists on the same feature branch.
challenge.finding: Branch-based selection could launder stale browser evidence into the current transaction.
challenge.resolution: Producer selection and artifact validation are exact-head; branch alone is never sufficient.

challenge.scenario: GitHub reports workflow success but the downloaded Template Factory manifest is incomplete or contains errors.
challenge.finding: Transport status could override semantic producer truth.
challenge.resolution: Require both successful workflow conclusion and validated machine-readable manifest contract/checksum/source identity/browser completeness.

challenge.scenario: The active Completion Contract contains no supported external guard.
challenge.finding: A global wait would slow every development transaction and couple unrelated work to Template Factory.
challenge.resolution: Requirement detection is contract-driven; no reference means no wait, no artifact download and no synthesized evidence.

challenge.scenario: The handoff implementation itself changes after resumable verification promotion.
challenge.finding: Old promotion credit could authorize physical evidence reuse under new semantics.
challenge.resolution: Include handoff implementation and CI wiring in verification-engine identity and regression-test the binding.

challenge.scenario: A required external guard is referenced but no explicit producer adapter exists.
challenge.finding: Generic acceptance of arbitrary workflow artifacts would create an unbounded trust channel.
challenge.resolution: Unsupported external guard IDs fail visible and require an explicit validator before they can contribute evidence.

challenge.scenario: Two external records for the same guard are available for one exact head.
challenge.finding: Ambiguous evidence selection could hide a failed or contradictory producer run.
challenge.resolution: Duplicate external guard evidence is rejected; one exact producer identity must be selected deterministically.

challenge.scenario: The external handoff code changes while an earlier resumable-verification promotion remains marked eligible.
challenge.finding: Physical reuse could continue under verification semantics that were never shadow-proven.
challenge.resolution: Bind the handoff module and CI wiring into verification-engine identity so semantic changes invalidate prior promotion evidence.

challenge.scenario: Completion Contract uses intuitive dimension labels such as provenance/evidence that are not canonical dimensions declared by its evidence guards.
challenge.finding: Sentinel correctly treats semantic synonyms as unproven rather than guessing equivalence, so a human-readable claim can still be machine-invalid.
challenge.resolution: Bind Completion claimScope dimensions to the exact Guard Registry vocabulary currently proven by the referenced guards; semantic aliases do not count as proof.

proofPlan: Implement structured Completion Contract evidence reference extraction and derive non-local required guards relative to the existing verification plan.
Implement a Template Factory external-proof validator for workflow identity, exact head/branch/state/run, manifest contract/checksum/errors and complete browser evidence.
Merge only validated required external evidence into the existing final-evidence-manifest; missing or invalid required records make Resumable Verification BLOCK.
Wire CI to resolve/download/validate GUARD-TEMPLATE-FACTORY only when required by the active Completion Contract.
Add handoff implementation to verification-engine identity.
Adversarially test missing, failed, stale, wrong-head, wrong-branch, malformed, incomplete and unrequested evidence cases.
Run exact-head Quality, TypeScript, Production Build, Resumable Verification and Completion Truth.
Confirm isolated Release Risk stays within budget and no Builder/Template Factory product files are part of this foundation diff.

reviews.reason: Reuses canonical Completion Truth and Resumable Verification; no second gate.
Isolated foundation is intentionally limited to quality/release infrastructure.
Exact-state provenance and artifact semantics are preserved instead of inferred.
Closes the exact class of decision/provenance divergence exposed by the revalidation run.

specialistReviews.finding: Completion Truth and Resumable Verification already own development-completion evidence aggregation.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the handoff as evidence transport only and do not introduce a new blocking owner.

specialistReviews.finding: A workflow-level SUCCESS is insufficient because stale or internally BLOCKed artifacts can coexist with wrapper success.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require exact-head producer identity plus machine-readable artifact contract/checksum/coverage and fail closed on any mismatch.

specialistReviews.finding: Cross-workflow transport touches release orchestration and can exceed risk budget when mixed with Builder/Factory product work.
specialistReviews.resolution: Isolate this foundation to quality/release infrastructure and keep the Brabus product revalidation in its own transaction.

specialistReviews.finding: Removing sibling evidence from Completion Contract avoids deadlock but creates false completion; re-running the producer inside CI duplicates proof authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Detect required non-local evidence from the Completion Contract, wait boundedly for the canonical producer, normalize evidence, then reuse existing Completion Truth.

requirements.requirement: Required external Completion evidence is derived from the active Completion Contract and only unsupported/non-local guards are handed to explicit validators.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Transactions with no external proof requirement do not wait for Template Factory.

requirements.requirement: External Template Factory proof is accepted only when workflow and artifact truth match the same exact Development Transaction.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Wrong-head, wrong-branch, failed, malformed, incomplete or contradictory external proof cannot become PASS.

requirements.requirement: Validated external proof is merged into the existing Resumable Verification evidence manifest and remains required by the existing Completion Truth authority when referenced.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No second completion gate or release authority is introduced.

notes: Isolated foundation extracted from the Brabus revalidation after Release Risk correctly blocked the mixed 4-subsystem/7-point Development Transaction. This branch changes only quality/release evidence transport. It does not implement or modify any Builder, template, Runtime or Factory maturity capability. Exact-head Quality exposed two proof-model issues: the handoff regression searched a fail-closed code in the wrapper instead of its owning helper, and Sentinel rejected noncanonical Completion claim dimensions. Both are repaired at their actual semantic owner; Sentinel is not weakened.
